remaining_problems.measured: Lower skirt lags the ornaments by 12 f with 175 px amplitude; hem lags by 18 f with 241 px (r 0.99 at those lags). The cone hem has no lag; its centre x vs source hem: corr 0.28 at lag 0.
remaining_problems.proposed_fix: Note in the handoff that the hem motion has to come from the model's skirt physics. Optionally add skirt bones keyed with the measured 12-18 f lag, or show a physics skirt in the preview instead of a rigid cone.

remaining_problems.problem: The pelvis twist is unconstrained. Part of the 2D skirt targets is met by 下半身 yaw acting on the 8 cm forward skirt offset, and nothing in the source measures that yaw. Ornament separation, the only yaw cue, does not correlate either way.
remaining_problems.measured: 下半身 yaw 35.6 deg p5-p95 (old 9.7 deg); roll 23.1 deg; pitch 17.4 deg. An axis point 0.30 m below the waist moves 116 px vs 154 px for the fitted skirt points. Model ornament-separation change 3% vs source 10%, corr -0.01.
remaining_problems.proposed_fix: Add a yaw prior on 下半身 (sigma about 8 deg), or put the skirt targets on the bone axis so the swing has to come from roll and translation.

remaining_problems.problem: Small upper-body reprojection regression after the lift and reach change. The torso is more upright (median tilt 19.4 -> 16.2 deg) and the neck sits lower. Rail contact is unchanged.
remaining_problems.measured: Neck median 9.6 -> 15.2 px (mean error +14.8 px downward). r_shoulder 8.7 -> 16.2 px. l_shoulder p90 22.1 -> 34.9 px. All keypoints p90 27.9 -> 34.8 px. At 272 px per 10 cm this is about 2-3 mm. Forearm-midpoint z minus rail: +3.2 / +5.3 cm in both fits.
remaining_problems.proposed_fix: Raise the neck and shoulder weight, or relax the DS センター prior around -lift (sigma 0.06 m) so the torso tilt can return to about 19 deg.

remaining_problems.problem: The 'no floating feet' claim is misleading. The IK targets reach the ankles, but the targets ride on a lifted 全ての親 in absolute MMD units, so the character stands 8-11 cm above the floor. That shows from any other camera and changes with a different model's leg length.
remaining_problems.measured: CL shot 3: ankles 20.1 cm above the stage (rest 9.6 cm). DS: 20.5 cm in shot 1 and 17.7 cm in shot 2 above the 4.05 m floor (rest 9.5 cm). VMD 全ての親 Y: 1.314 / 1.373 / 1.024 units.
remaining_problems.proposed_fix: Fix the anchor and camera geometry instead of lifting (see the shot 2 knee problem). Otherwise document the per-shot root lift in the handoff and how to remove it for other cameras or models.
